description: Opinionated Plugins for Claude Code & Antigravity
name: virajp-plugins

plugins.description: The developer-machine toolchain in one plugin — mise (the .config/ three-file MISE_ENV split, tool/env placement, the file-based task library, the CI node-gpg workaround) plus /devtools:scaffold and the repo-level quality gates: dprint, ESLint, gitleaks, grype, pre-commit. Its stack adapter retired in Wave C, its Docker/OCI doctrine in Wave D and its Doppler doctrine with the secrets-manager packs — the deploy artifact is now stackgen's container-image pack, the local stack its harness contract, and secrets a user-picked provider on the backing axis. This plugin holds no secrets doctrine at all.
plugins.name: devtools

plugins.description: The principles-driven stack materializer — implements the vwf stack-adapter contract with a dispatch rule that runs per component: a component a shipped pack covers is copied verbatim; an uncovered one is generated (per-topic Context7 research → vwf's principles catalog → the stackgen-skill-reviewer gate, capped at four rounds). Both paths land directly in the repo's committed .claude/ tree — skills, agents, hooks and rules only, never LSP config — shaped by a closed kind vocabulary, recorded per component in a lockfile, editable and plugin-independent for collaborators. Re-sync is explicit, per component and lockfile-diffed, never silent. Ships 23 packs and 25 bundles across nine kinds (language-bundle, database, cloud-provider, repo-gate, capability-provider, ci-system, app-framework, deploy-target, design-tool); a bundle is a recorded composition of component refs, never a directory. Two tool axes (design, cicd) let a pack be reached by the config token that selects it, which is what rescued a CI pack no menu could offer. assets/artifact-doctrine.md carries the host rules deciding whether a generated skill, agent or hook is valid at all, and assets/contracts/ the provider-neutral capability doctrine each category is compared against. .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json are each written only behind their own explicit consent line, merging never owning.
plugins.name: stackgen

plugins.description: Highly opinionated Product → Blueprint → Plan → Execute workflow for solo developers or small teams — enforced workspace structure with a selectable stack-template menu checked by /vwf:doctor, a flow-first blueprint (entities as data contracts, OpenAPI + JSON-Schema artifacts) with whole-product coherence review, chained dependency plans, an autonomous execute with review/security/acceptance/UX subagents behind one final merge gate that stamps blueprint implementation state, post-deploy verify with production release freezing + API backward-compat enforcement, feedback intake, and mempalace-backed memory.
plugins.name: vwf
